body.zh-Hant: 1889年4月20日生於奧地利因河畔布勞瑙，父親為海關官員阿洛伊斯·希特勒。1905年未取得畢業資格即離開實科中學，回到林茨。1907年遷居維也納，報考藝術學院未獲錄取，其後居無定所，最後住進收容所，靠零工維生。1913年5月24日遷往慕尼黑。
body.en: Born on 20 April 1889 in Braunau am Inn, Austria, the son of customs official Alois Hitler. He left the Realschule in 1905 without a final examination and returned to Linz. In 1907 he moved to Vienna, applied unsuccessfully to the Academy of Fine Arts, and later lived without a fixed home, ending up in a homeless shelter and doing casual work. On 24 May 1913 he moved to Munich.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰與國防軍
heading.en: First World War and the Reichswehr

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月16日以志願兵身分加入巴伐利亞後備步兵第16團（List團），參與西線作戰，最後階級為上等兵，曾負傷，獲一級鐵十字勳章等勳獎。1916年10月在西線腿部重傷。1918年10月15日遭毒氣攻擊；在帕澤瓦爾克的野戰醫院經歷戰爭結束，11月底回到慕尼黑，後為國防軍擔任線人與宣傳講員。1920年3月31日自國防軍退伍。
body.en: On 16 August 1914 he joined the Bavarian Reserve Infantry Regiment No. 16 (List) as a volunteer and fought on the Western Front, ending as a Gefreiter; he was wounded and received the Iron Cross First Class among other awards. In October 1916 he suffered a severe leg wound on the Western Front. On 15 October 1918 he was hit in a gas attack; he experienced the end of the war in a military hospital at Pasewalk, returned to Munich at the end of November, and later served the Reichswehr as an informant and indoctrination speaker. He was discharged from the Reichswehr on 31 March 1920.

heading.zh-Hant: 進入政黨與慕尼黑政變
heading.en: Entry into the party and the Munich putsch

body.zh-Hant: 1919年9月12日參加德意志工人黨集會，數日後入黨，黨員編號555；該黨1920年改名國家社會主義德意志工人黨（NSDAP）。1921年7月29日起任該黨第一主席。1923年11月8日至9日在慕尼黑發動政變失敗，逃亡兩天後在烏芬被捕，黨遭禁止。1924年以叛國罪受審，被判五年要塞監禁，在蘭茨貝格服刑期間開始撰寫《我的奮鬥》第一卷，同年12月20日提前獲釋。
body.en: On 12 September 1919 he attended a meeting of the German Workers' Party and joined it a few days later with membership number 555; the party was renamed NSDAP in 1920. From 29 July 1921 he was its first chairman. His putsch in Munich on 8–9 November 1923 failed; he fled and was arrested two days later in Uffing, and the party was banned. In 1924 he was tried for high treason and sentenced to five years' fortress confinement; in Landsberg he began writing the first volume of Mein Kampf, and he was released early on 20 December 1924.

heading.en: Refounding the party and electoral rise

body.zh-Hant: 1925年2月27日重建NSDAP；同年4月應本人申請喪失奧地利國籍，其後巴伐利亞政府禁止他公開演說。1930年9月14日國會選舉，NSDAP得票18.2%，成為第二大黨團。1932年2月26日取得德國國籍；同年總統選舉第一輪得票約30%、第二輪近37%，興登堡連任。1932年7月31日國會選舉NSDAP得票37.8%，成為第一大黨。
body.en: He refounded the NSDAP on 27 February 1925; in April that year he lost his Austrian citizenship at his own request, after which the Bavarian government banned him from public speaking. In the Reichstag election of 14 September 1930 the NSDAP won 18.2% and became the second-largest group. He obtained German citizenship on 26 February 1932; in that year's presidential election he won about 30% in the first round and almost 37% in the second, and Hindenburg was re-elected. In the Reichstag election of 31 July 1932 the NSDAP won 37.8% and became the largest party.

body.zh-Hant: 1933年1月30日獲任命為總理；3月24日國會通過《授權法》。1934年6月30日藉「羅姆事件」清除衝鋒隊並殺害多名政敵；8月2日興登堡去世，依前一日通過的法律合併總統與總理職權，稱「元首兼總理」，軍隊向他宣誓效忠。1935年紐倫堡種族法通過。1938年2月4日親自接掌國防軍最高指揮權，3月德奧合併，9月29日慕尼黑協定使蘇台德地區劃歸德國；11月9日與戈培爾發動十一月大迫害。1939年3月15日國防軍佔領捷克斯洛伐克，8月23日簽訂德蘇條約。
body.en: On 30 January 1933 he was appointed Chancellor; on 24 March the Enabling Act was passed. On 30 June 1934, in the Röhm affair, he eliminated the SA leadership and had numerous political opponents killed; when Hindenburg died on 2 August he combined the offices of President and Chancellor under a law passed the previous day, taking the title Führer und Reichskanzler, and the armed forces swore allegiance to him. The Nuremberg race laws were passed in 1935. On 4 February 1938 he took personal command of the Wehrmacht; Austria was annexed in March, and the Munich Agreement of 29 September gave the Sudeten German areas to Germany; on 9 November he and Goebbels instigated the pogrom night. On 15 March 1939 the Wehrmacht occupied Czechoslovakia, and on 23 August the Hitler–Stalin Pact was concluded.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰與死亡

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月1日德國進攻波蘭，9月3日英法宣戰。1940年4月9日開始佔領丹麥與挪威，5月10日發動對荷、比、法的西線戰役，6月22日與法國停戰。1941年6月22日進攻蘇聯，黨衛隊特別行動隊隨即開始有系統的屠殺；12月德國對美國宣戰，12月19日他兼掌陸軍指揮。1942年1月20日舉行萬湖會議，籌劃「猶太人問題最終解決」。1943年1月31日第6軍團在史達林格勒投降。1944年7月20日施陶芬貝格行刺未遂。1945年4月29日與愛娃·布勞恩結婚，4月30日在總理府地堡自殺。
body.en: Germany attacked Poland on 1 September 1939, and Britain and France declared war on 3 September. The occupation of Denmark and Norway began on 9 April 1940, the western campaign against the Netherlands, Belgium and France on 10 May, and an armistice with France followed on 22 June. Germany attacked the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941, and SS Einsatzgruppen began systematic killings; in December Germany declared war on the United States, and on 19 December he also took over command of the Army. The Wannsee Conference on the "Final Solution" met on 20 January 1942. The encircled 6th Army surrendered at Stalingrad on 31 January 1943. Stauffenberg's assassination attempt failed on 20 July 1944. He married Eva Braun on 29 April 1945 and killed himself in the bunker under the Reich Chancellery on 30 April.

body.zh-Hant: 1874年11月30日生於牛津郡布倫亨宮，出身富裕的貴族家庭；父親為倫道夫·邱吉爾勳爵，母親為美國人珍妮·傑羅姆。曾就讀哈羅公學與桑赫斯特。1895年加入騎兵，以軍人兼記者身分遊歷古巴、阿富汗、埃及與南非。
body.en: Born on 30 November 1874 at Blenheim Palace, Oxfordshire, into a rich aristocratic family; his father was Lord Randolph Churchill and his mother the American Jennie Jerome. He was educated at Harrow and Sandhurst. He joined the cavalry in 1895 and, as a soldier and part-time journalist, travelled to Cuba, Afghanistan, Egypt and South Africa.

heading.zh-Hant: 進入下議院與自由黨內閣
heading.en: Entering the Commons and Liberal office

body.zh-Hant: 1900年當選奧爾德姆選區的保守黨下議員，1904年轉投自由黨。其後選區先後為曼徹斯特西北（1906–1908）與丹地（1908年起）。在自由黨政府中歷任次官（1906–1908）、貿易委員會主席（1908–1910）與內政大臣（1910–1911）。
body.en: He was elected Conservative MP for Oldham in 1900 and defected to the Liberal Party in 1904. He then sat for Manchester North West (1906–1908) and Dundee (from 1908). In the Liberal government he served as Under-Secretary (1906–1908), President of the Board of Trade (1908–1910) and Home Secretary (1910–1911).

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍大臣與第一次世界大戰
heading.en: First Lord of the Admiralty and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1911年至1915年任海軍大臣（皇家海軍的文官政治首長）。加里波利戰役由他發起並以失利收場，他因此飽受批評而辭職，隨後親赴西線作戰。1917年再度入閣任部長。
body.en: From 1911 to 1915 he was First Lord of the Admiralty, the civil and political head of the Royal Navy. The Gallipoli campaign, which he initiated, ended in disaster; heavily criticised, he resigned and went to fight on the Western Front. In 1917 he returned to office as a minister.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年至1921年任國務大臣。戰間期由自由黨回歸保守黨，1924年起任財政大臣，並決定讓英國重返金本位。1924年至1945年為埃平選區議員。1929年保守黨敗選後，其後約11年大多不在政府任職，以寫作與演講為主；他堅決反對印度獨立，並警告對納粹德國的綏靖政策。
body.en: He was a Secretary of State from 1919 to 1921. Between the wars he crossed back from the Liberals to the Conservatives, and from 1924 served as Chancellor of the Exchequer, returning Britain to the Gold Standard. He sat for Epping from 1924 to 1945. After the Conservative defeat of 1929 he spent most of the next 11 years out of office, mainly writing and speaking; he firmly opposed Indian independence and warned against the appeasement of Nazi Germany.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰：海軍大臣與首相
heading.en: Second World War: Admiralty and premiership

body.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰爆發時再任海軍大臣。1940年5月10日接替辭職的張伯倫出任首相，領導各黨聯合政府，並自任國防大臣；任內演說被認為在艱困時期振奮了英國士氣。1944年《教育法》為其任內主要法案之一。1945年大選工黨的艾德禮獲勝，他於7月25日卸任首相。
body.en: At the outbreak of the Second World War he was again appointed First Lord of the Admiralty. On 10 May 1940 he succeeded the resigning Neville Chamberlain as Prime Minister of an all-party coalition and also took the post of Minister of Defence; his wartime speeches are credited with raising British morale. The Education Act 1944 was among the major acts of his premiership. After Clement Attlee's Labour victory in the 1945 general election he left office on 25 July.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後、第二次組閣與晚年
heading.en: Post-war years, second premiership and death

body.zh-Hant: 1946年在美國演說，稱「鐵幕」已在歐陸落下。1951年10月26日再任首相，1955年4月5日因健康不佳辭職，由外相兼副首相艾登接任。1953年獲諾貝爾文學獎，並受封爵士。1945年至1964年為伍德福德選區議員，1964年大選不再參選。1965年1月24日在倫敦逝世，獲國葬。
body.en: In a 1946 speech in the United States he declared that an "iron curtain" had descended across the Continent. He became Prime Minister again on 26 October 1951 and resigned through ill health on 5 April 1955, making way for Anthony Eden, his Foreign Secretary and Deputy Prime Minister. In 1953 he received the Nobel Prize in Literature and a knighthood. He sat for Woodford from 1945 to 1964 and did not stand at the 1964 general election. He died in London on 24 January 1965 and was given a state funeral.

heading.zh-Hant: 關東軍參謀長至陸軍大臣
heading.en: From Kwantung Army chief of staff to Army Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1937年任關東軍參謀長，翌年任陸軍次官，以幹練被稱為「剃刀東條」。歷任航空總監兼航空本部長後，1940年起在第2次、第3次近衛內閣擔任陸軍大臣（第2次近衛內閣於1940年7月22日成立，第3次於1941年7月18日成立）。
body.en: In 1937 he became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army and the following year Vice-Minister of the Army, where his efficiency earned him the nickname "Razor Tōjō". After serving as Inspector-General of Army Aviation and head of the Army Aeronautical Department, he was Army Minister in the second and third Konoe cabinets from 1940 (formed on 22 July 1940 and 18 July 1941 respectively).

body.zh-Hant: 1941年10月18日接替近衛文麿出任首相，兼任陸軍大臣與內務大臣。在對美英開戰初期作戰成功的背景下，1942年以候選人推薦制度舉行「翼贊選舉」，議會因而形骸化，獨裁式的戰時體制得到強化。任內曾短期兼任外務大臣、文部大臣、商工大臣，1943年11月1日起兼任軍需大臣。1944年2月兼任參謀總長，但隨戰局惡化，重臣間批評升高，內閣於同年7月總辭（官邸記在職至1944年7月22日）。
body.en: On 18 October 1941 he succeeded Konoe Fumimaro as Prime Minister, also holding the posts of Army Minister and Home Minister. Against the background of early military success in the war against the United States and Britain, he held the 1942 "Imperial Rule Assistance" election under a system of recommended candidates, which hollowed out the Diet and strengthened a dictatorial wartime regime. He briefly held the foreign, education and commerce-and-industry portfolios concurrently, and from 1 November 1943 was also Munitions Minister. In February 1944 he also became Chief of the Army General Staff, but as the war situation worsened criticism among the senior statesmen grew and the cabinet resigned in July (the Kantei gives his tenure as ending on 22 July 1944).

body.en: Born in São Borja, Rio Grande do Sul, on 19 April; the two sources disagree on the year (see gaps). The Dicionário Histórico-Biográfico Brasileiro records that as a young man he changed his birth year to 1883. He enlisted in the army in February 1899 and entered the Porto Alegre Law School in March 1904; he became a lawyer.

body.zh-Hant: 以南大河共和黨（PRR）身分任州議員（1909–1912、1917–1921），1922年10月當選聯邦眾議員，1924年連任（1923–1926）。1926年11月15日華盛頓·路易斯總統就職時出任財政部長，至1927年12月。1928年1月25日就任南大河州主席。1929年8月「自由聯盟」推舉他為總統候選人，敗給聖保羅的儒利奧·普雷斯特斯後，策動推翻華盛頓·路易斯，終成1930年革命。
body.en: As a member of the Partido Republicano Rio-Grandense (PRR) he was a state deputy (1909–1912, 1917–1921), was elected to the federal Chamber of Deputies in October 1922 and re-elected in 1924 (1923–1926). When President Washington Luís took office on 15 November 1926 he became Finance Minister, serving until December 1927. He took office as President of Rio Grande do Sul on 25 January 1928. In August 1929 the Liberal Alliance nominated him for the presidency; defeated by Júlio Prestes, he organised the movement that deposed Washington Luís, culminating in the Revolution of 1930.

body.zh-Hant: 軍政委員會過渡之後，1930年11月3日就任臨時政府首長。1932年聖保羅爆發反瓦加斯的立憲革命，遭政府鎮壓。1934年憲法頒布後，由制憲議會選為總統。其後政府打擊1935年的共產黨起事，國會頒布《國家安全法》。
body.en: After the interim military junta, he took office as head of the provisional government on 3 November 1930. The government fought the anti-Vargas Constitutionalist Revolution launched in São Paulo in 1932. After the 1934 Constitution was promulgated he was elected President by the Constituent Assembly. The government later suppressed the communist movement of 1935, and Congress enacted the National Security Law.

heading.zh-Hant: 新國家體制與第二次世界大戰
heading.en: Estado Novo and the Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 1937年11月10日宣布解散國會並頒布新憲章，開啟「新國家」體制；1938年面對整合主義者的武裝起事。執政期間推動八小時工作日、勞動手冊與最低工資等勞工立法。1942年8月31日在盟國（尤其美國）與國內輿論壓力下對軸心國宣戰，1944年派遣巴西遠征軍赴義大利作戰。1945年10月29日被推翻。
body.en: On 10 November 1937 he announced the dissolution of Congress and decreed a new charter, beginning the Estado Novo; in 1938 he faced the Integralist uprising. His government introduced labour legislation including the eight-hour day, the work card and the minimum wage. On 31 August 1942, under pressure from the Allies, above all the United States, and from domestic opinion, Brazil declared war on the Axis, and in 1944 sent the Brazilian Expeditionary Force to fight in Italy. He was deposed on 29 October 1945.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、第二任總統與死亡

body.zh-Hant: 1946年至1949年以社會民主黨（PSD）身分任參議員。1950年代表他於1945年創立的巴西工黨（PTB）參選總統，1950年10月3日以48.7%得票當選，1951年1月31日就職。第二任期內設立國家經濟開發銀行（1952）與巴西石油公司（1953）。1954年8月24日在里約熱內盧自殺，留下〈遺書〉。
body.en: From 1946 to 1949 he was a senator for the Partido Social Democrático (PSD). In 1950 he ran for president for the Partido Trabalhista Brasileiro (PTB), which he had founded in 1945, was elected on 3 October 1950 with 48.7% of the vote and took office on 31 January 1951. His second government created the National Economic Development Bank (1952) and Petrobras (1953). He killed himself in Rio de Janeiro on 24 August 1954, leaving the document known as the carta-testamento.
